Question that came up in the Discord

Can you lock Gather to use its effect in the influence phase of other Methuselahs?

Gather

Cardtype: Action
Clan: Gangrel
Cost: 1 pool
+1 stealth action. Unique.
Put this card in play, locked, and choose a younger Gangrel in your uncontrolled region. During the influence phase, you may lock this card to move that Gangrel from your uncontrolled region to your ready region, with any counters he or she has, unless that Gangrel would contest a vampire in play. Any vampire can burn this card as a  action that costs 1 pool.
